what: Paraíba: weekly data and transmission changing every four weeks
title: SIRD-GA from daily cases and deaths
text: application aggregates daily counts 2020 complete epidemiological weeks (daily counts carry strong weekly reporting cycle) lets transmission rate change every four weeks sird_ga_fit_tv(). Rates per week. model can written general engine (vignette("compartmental-models")): ga_model() infection, recovery death events, ga_incidence() streams infection death, blocks = list(lambda = blk) ga_fit().
code: data(paraiba_covid19) data(paraiba_population) d <- paraiba_covid19 wk <- d$epi_week keep <- wk %in% names(which(table(wk) == 7)) cases <- as.numeric(tapply(d$new_cases[keep], wk[keep], sum)) deaths <- as.numeric(tapply(d$new_deaths[keep], wk[keep], sum)) blk <- ceiling(seq_along(cases) / 4) c(weeks = length(cases), blocks = max(blk)) #>  weeks blocks  #>     40     10 rem <- 7 / 7  # removal rate per week for a mean infectious period of 7 days st <- list(lambda = rep(1.2 * rem, max(blk)), gamma = 0.98 * rem, alpha = 0.02 * rem,            i0 = 5e-6, p = 0.2, tau2 = 20, tau2_d = 2) f <- sird_ga_fit_tv(cases, deaths, paraiba_population, blk, "both", st, nsub = 20L) 7 / (f$theta[["gamma"]] + f$theta[["alpha"]])   # mean infectious period, days tapply(f$R_t, blk, mean)                         # reproduction number by block
